summary: Jennifer Pattison Tuohy of The Verge rounds up smart home deals during Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days. Categories include robot vacuums, security cameras and doorbells, smart speakers, and lighting, locks, thermostats and outdoor gear. The piece notes prices, discounts and key features, with several picks tied to Matter and Apple Home compatibility, and says it will be updated through the sale.
one_line: The Verge's roundup of the best smart home deals on robot vacuums, cameras, speakers, lighting and thermostats during Amazon's October 2023 Prime Big Deal Days.
key_facts: Ecovacs' Deebot X2 Omni flagship robot vacuum and mop is down from $1,499.99 to $1,199.99 at Amazon; it has a square shape and can lift its mops 15mm to avoid wetting carpets.
The Yeedi Cube is billed as the first budget robot vacuum mop with a self-emptying, self-washing, self-filling dock, priced at $559.99 at Amazon, $140 off.
The Roomba Combo j7 Plus, the first Roomba to also mop, is $799 at Amazon, down from $1,100; the Roomba j6 Plus is $399.99.
The Roborock Q5 Plus self-emptying robot vacuum with lidar navigation is $399.99, 43% off, and is one of the few Roborocks sold without a mop.
The Roomba 692 is down from $299.99 to $165, and the Shark Ion AV753 is $129.99 ($100 off).
The Ring Floodlight Cam Wired Pro is $50 off at $199.99, with radar motion detection and 2,000-lumen floodlights; higher-end Ring cameras are seeing up to $100 off.
Google's Nest Cam with floodlight is $80 off at $199.99 and is one of the only floodlight cameras offering 24/7 recording.
Arlo's Essential Spotlight Camera three-pack is $130 ($44 each), works over Wi-Fi without a hub, and needs a monthly subscription for smart alerts.
The Echo (fourth-gen) is $55 and acts as a Matter controller, Thread border router and Zigbee bridge.
The newer Google Nest Thermostat is $40 off at $89.99 and is described as the only thermostat that works with the Matter standard.
The Ecobee Smart Thermostat Premium is $210 (16% off), and a Philips Hue starter kit with a Hue Bridge is $75.99, $55 off.
The Meross smart garage door controller is $39.99 and works with Alexa, Google Home and Apple Home; the Aqara FP2 presence sensor is $64.99 with a coupon.
